output.title: Mobile app push notifications not arriving
output.content: If push notifications aren't arriving on mobile, first check that notifications are allowed for the app in your phone's OS-level settings (Settings > Notifications on iOS, or App info > Notifications on Android). In-app notification toggles only work if OS-level permission is also granted.

output.title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
output.content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

steps.rawOutput:
---

**Reply to customer:**

Thanks for reaching out. I'm sorry to hear push notifications have stopped coming through—I'd like to help get that working again.

The most common cause is that OS-level notification permissions for the app may have been disabled on your phone. Even if the in-app notification settings are turned on, the app still needs permission granted at the phone's system level to deliver notifications.

Here's what to check:

**On iOS:** Go to Settings > Notifications and look for the app. Make sure notifications are allowed.

**On Android:** Go to App info > Notifications and verify that notifications are enabled.

If you've already checked these settings and they're enabled, or if re-enabling them doesn't resolve the issue, please let me know and we can investigate further. It would also be helpful to know:
- What phone and OS version you're using
- When exactly the notifications stopped coming through

Thanks!
